description.en: The application ID. You create and view this ID in the console. Only one ID is supported.
The number of entries per page.

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本接口用于查询单AppId下的全部进行中的频道列表。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### Usage notes

You can use this operation to retrieve a list of all active channels for a single AppId.

### QPS limit

The per-user QPS limit for this operation is 10 calls per second. If you exceed this limit, rate limiting is triggered, which may affect your business. Call this operation only as needed.
